caption: The drawing shows a single, black ballet shoe with criss-crossed straps, depicted in a realistic style using pencil and possibly colored pencil. The shoe is oriented with the heel to the left and the toe pointing to the right, and it is drawn with shading to indicate its three-dimensional form. The main shoe is placed within a large, faint rectangular outline, as if it is centered on a blank page. Above and to the right of the main shoe, there is a smaller, simplified line drawing showing the sole and contours of the shoe, placed within a smaller rectangle; both rectangles are marked as if attached to the page using small, drawn pieces of tape at their corners. The shoe's upper surface is black with subtle highlights, and the inside is shaded a lighter color, suggesting an off-white or cream-colored lining. The rest of the page is mostly blank with a light tan color consistent with aged paper.
title: Black Leather Slipper
